packageRules.description: Tycho 0.25 is tied to the Eclipse 3.7 target platform and to Maven 3.6.3; moving it means migrating the whole build, so Renovate leaves it alone
Merge patch updates of dependencies once the required build check (which runs the tests) passes. Minor and major updates are never merged automatically: each version gets its own PR for review
Merge all GitHub Actions updates, majors included, once the required build check passes, but not before a release is 3 days old; master only accepts squash merges
